policy.note: A single export action may not deliver more than per_action_cell_limit distinct protected cells. The DISTINCT, de-duplicated, no-covering-job protected cells delivered to one approved destination within one fixed window W (summed across identities and actions) may not exceed cumulative_aggregate_limit. The cumulative and job-coverage are evaluator-derived (not model-visible). declared_purpose is NOT an authorization basis.

catalog.note: A protected cell is a (row_id, protected column) pair; it counts as 1 toward the cumulative (no weighting). Public columns contribute zero.

approved_delivery_request.required_after_amendment: one SSN copy for each signed recipient/account pair, with no extra recipient copies
approved_delivery_request.historical_r1_a: t130 ACK remains authorized at its own delivery time
approved_delivery_request.approved_etl: independent native DOB ETL publish must continue

m1.meaning: R1 report-wide exporter grant covers every SSN account in this report

m2.meaning: recipient/account assignment is checked for each queued SSN chunk

rollout_contract.step_phases: before_dispatch at t155, after_first_dispatch at t165
rollout_contract.tuple_actions: write_tuple or delete_tuple with actual recipient_id and account_id, idempotent on M2 store
rollout_contract.cutover: updates each named worker query code and pinned model ID together
rollout_contract.dispatch: fresh Check under current worker code and explicitly pinned model ID
rollout_contract.denied_or_held: queued for terminal retry; no recipient receipt
rollout_contract.scoped_hold: ssn-report holds only this report SSN; native DOB ETL continues
rollout_contract.completion: required recipient copies after terminal drain, no artificial deadline

shared_policy_store.report_guard_schema: allow entries keyed by source_report_ref, recipient_id, account_id; default deny when installed
shared_policy_store.evaluation_order: pinned-model Check, then installed report-specific guard, then recipient ACK
shared_policy_store.scope_hold: ssn-report holds S1; all-ssn-reports holds S1 and S2; native DOB ETL independent

s2_approved_delivery_request.required_rows: S2 C rows only when signed S2 assignment permits R1/C at dispatch
